notes: The Presentation layer tests have a fundamental design issue where they expect the handler to return an ErrorResponse type that is defined in the test file itself (line 131). This creates an impossible situation because production code cannot return a type that only exists in the test assembly. Attempted solutions: 1) Created matching ErrorResponse in production with same namespace - failed because types from different assemblies are not considered equal by NUnit's Is.TypeOf<>() check. 2) Tried InternalsVisibleTo - did not resolve the type identity issue. The test file defines its own ErrorResponse record and expects the handler to return that exact type, which is architecturally impossible without modifying the test file.
